claims.claim_text: The indexed Robert C. Caldwell is confirmed as the exact person recorded entering the United States Army as a private on May 6, 1942.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The OSS index and official Army merged record agree on the exact name and private identifier.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private-identifier and exact-name agreement across two official NARA records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record dates entry on May 6, 1942; it does not establish the Army-to-OSS transfer date.
claims.match_notes: The full identifier remains private. The source's civilian-occupation value is an undefined code and is not interpreted as an occupation or employer.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index gives Robert C. Caldwell and a private identifier in Box 101. The exact official Army record repeats both, records entry as a private from civil life on May 6, 1942, and carries an undefined civilian-occupation code that is not interpreted.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified. Review Box 101 for the meaning of the undefined occupation code, employer, Army unit, OSS assignment, and chronology.
